_meta.purpose: Declarative spec for all X-Content-Engine scheduled tasks. The runtime is `mavis cron`; this file is the version-controlled source of truth that documents what crons exist, why, and when they fire. The chief (Mavis) is responsible for keeping this file in sync with the actual `mavis cron list mavis` output.
_meta.operational_runbook: see `mavis cron info mavis <cronName>` for runtime state

jobs.name: xce-feedback-backstop
jobs.purpose: Verification backstop for the feedback loop. Catches the case where Andre publishes a draft and forgets to log the URL in queue/drafts-published.mdl. The actual publish-tied crons (xce-feedback-YYYY-MM-DD) are created on-demand by the chief at publish time; this is the catch-all.
jobs.trigger: one-shot, 7 days after this spec was written (2026-06-24 09:00 CT)
jobs.lifecycle: fire once → check loop state → delete self. If loop is healthy (real publish-tied crons are firing), downgrade to weekly cadence. If loop is broken (no real crons firing, no publishes logged), surface to Andre.
post_fire_actions: Read queue/drafts-published.mdl — note any new entries not yet closed by a real feedback cron
If unpublished entries > 7 days old: surface to Andre as a reminder to log the URL or to confirm the post wasn't published (e.g., scheduled for later)
If unpublished entries > 14 days old: page Andre (the loop is broken)
Check mavis cron list mavis for any xce-feedback-* crons that should have fired but didn't

jobs.name: xce-feedback-{publish_date}
jobs.purpose: The real feedback-loop cron. Created on-demand by the chief at publish time. Fires 3-5 days after Andre publishes a draft, prompts Mavis to run x-analytics-tracker in 7-day window mode, then deletes itself.
jobs.creation_command_template: see agents/feedback-loop.md §2 'The cron creation step' for the full template
jobs.lifecycle: fire once → run x-analytics-tracker → write to dashboard + brain → append to drafts/_ledger.mdl → delete self
jobs.creation_trigger: Stage 4 in team-config.md — Andre publishes a draft, chief logs the URL, chief creates this cron
jobs.name_convention: xce-feedback-YYYY-MM-DD (one per publish date; chief dedupes on date if multiple drafts published same day)

not_yet_scheduled.purpose: Weekly bookmarks → brief → draft cycle. Triggered when Andre picks 'light' cadence (1/week).
